mapper.select: SELECT policy_code, policy_name, risk_dimension, hit_action, risk_level, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_policy ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT rule_code, rule_name, target_type, scene_code, limit_value, time_window, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_limit_rule ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT block_code, subject_value, subject_type, reason, action_type, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_blocklist ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT event_no, payment_order_id, hit_policy, risk_level, decision_result, source_system, FORMATDATETIME(happened_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS happenedAt FROM t_risk_intercept_event ORDER BY happened_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT review_no, business_no, risk_tag, review_item, status, status_type, reviewer, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_review_order ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT monitor_code, monitor_name, monitor_target, alert_threshold, notify_policy, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_monitor_rule ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_policy WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_limit_rule WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_review_order WHERE status = 'PENDING'
